summary: Hunt your prey, grow and evolve sharks in a 3D action adventure survival game
description:
Become the ultimate predator in this offline adventure shark game where you’ll rule the ocean and eat your way through an underwater open world to explore 🦈🦈🦈🦈
 
Take control of a mighty, hungry shark and survive as long as possible by eating everything in sight! In this thrilling, classic adventure, play as a shark and evolve your predator into a fierce sea beast, from Great Whites to the ferocious Megalodon, and explore the ocean’s depths filled with fish, animals, and other creatures.
 
Unleash Your Predator Potential!
It’s eat or be eaten in this shark adventure simulator where your mission is simple: explore, grow, evolve and survive. Start as a small fish and work your way up the ocean’s food chain, evolving your shark through multiple levels until you dominate the underwater world! Hunt, eat, and attack whales, fish, birds, and more. This offline game lets you explore its open world, and feels like an RPG. Play offline without Wi-Fi while keeping the action going.
 
Equip Powerful Gear and Accessories!
Boost your shark with awesome accessories like jetpacks, lasers, and even fancy hats! Equip your shark to grow up, swim faster, bite harder, and survive longer as you navigate the open world.
 
Meet Your Baby Shark Companion!
Need help exploring the open world? Recruit baby sharks to join you in the hunt! Each baby shark offers unique stats to assist you on your journey, similar to an RPG. Evolve your sea animal and watch your baby shark’s powers grow with you as you dive deeper into a real shark adventure game.
 
Survival of the Hungriest!
The ocean is an open world full of surprises and challenges. As a shark, it’s your job to keep eating and evolving. Be wary of dangers lurking in the deep, but know that each meal makes you stronger. Take a bite of everything and discover the thrill of survival in a classic retro game!

Looking for a deeper adventure?
Try Hungry Shark World, the modern arcade shark experience with fast, endless runs—perfect for playing anytime, anywhere.
 
Game Features:
   •  Play as one of many different sharks and animals, including iconic predators like the Great White, Hammerhead, and Megalodon.
  •  Dive into an open world of fish, animals, and prey, hunting for your next meal as you evolve in size and strength.
  •  Grow and evolve over a dozen unique fish, sharks, and baby sharks, each bringing a new layer of RPG strategy to your adventure.
  •  Equip powerful accessories like jetpacks, lasers, and top hats to customize your shark and make it the ultimate predator.
  •  Activate Gold Rush to extend survival and score big points in this adventure-style shark game.
  •  Level up each shark's unique stats RPG-style to build your perfect underwater team.
  
Additional Information:
This game contains in-app purchases for Gems and Coins to enhance gameplay. You can also earn Gems and Coins in-game or by watching ads. This game remains fully playable offline!
